simBanner: Sim Mode · Local preview only: commands are not sent to the arm, and the simulated pose is discarded when you switch back to Real

fault.controller: The controller is in a fault state
fault.stateHint: The controller is in its fault state: any safety violation (overspeed, feedback timeout, settle timeout) sets it, and neither Clear Fault (which clears only the drives' latched faults) nor Reset (which only resets the controller) is guaranteed to release it — disable and re-enable the arm (it goes limp, hold it first), or restart the console.

controlBar.enableTitle: Energise the drives and hold the current pose
controlBar.disableTitle: Cut motor torque: the arm drops under gravity, support it first
controlBar.resetTitle: Reset the controller: clear latched faults and re-anchor the trajectory reference to the current pose (an in-flight Cartesian plan is discarded; not a full reboot)
controlBar.clearFaultTitle: Clear the RAM fault bits latched in the drives (press this first once an overcurrent / overtemp cause is gone; a controller fault state still needs a disable and re-enable)
controlBar.homeTitle: Move to the zero pose (all axes 0 rad)
controlBar.zeroGravityOnTitle: Leave zero gravity: restore position control and hold the current pose
controlBar.zeroGravityOffTitle: Enter zero gravity: zero torque while energised, drag the arm by hand to teach
controlBar.readyPoseTitle: Move to recommended ready pose Home

cartesian.title: End-effector Trim
cartesian.simHint: Sim mode only supports joint space operations
cartesian.unsupportedHint: This firmware was built without cartesian planning (linear motion unavailable)
cartesian.poseUnavailable: No cartesian pose: this firmware has no cartesian planning

jointSpace.title: Joint Space
jointSpace.releaseOnlyTitle: Send the command immediately when the slider is released, without pressing Send
